verdict.rationale: The California EDD is a government payroll-tax and unemployment-insurance service portal, not an AI agent or assistant, so acting as an MCP client that plugs in external MCP servers is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any agent or MCP-client capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
